Variants.Content: The legend of the Bloodstone Emperor marrying the Tiger Girl is one of the most bizarre episodes in the ancient history of the Far East. It may originate from tribes, totems, interracial marriages or exaggerations from later generations, which cannot be easily determined; in the structure of the story, she symbolizes the combination of the usurper and the power outside the human order.
